metadata.question: On June 24, 2025, was the temperature over John F. Kennedy International Airport higher than on any other day in June 2020 to 2024?

data.raw_code: The user is asking: "On June 24, 2025, was the temperature over John F. Kennedy International Airport higher than on any other day in June 2020 to 2024?" This requires: 1. Comparing temperature on June 24, 2025 vs max temperature in any June day from 2020-2024 2. Using temperature data (likely ERA5 or MODIS LST) 3. Location: JFK Airport (40.6413° N, 73.7781° W) 4. Time periods: - Single day: June 24, 2025 - Multi-year: All June days 2020-2024 (5 years × ~30 days = ~150 days) 5. Need to compute: a. Temperature on June 24, 2025 (daily max or mean?) b. Maximum temperature across all June days 2020-2024 c. Compare if (a) > (b) Strategy: 1. Use ERA5-Land hourly data for 2m temperature (most reliable) 2. For each day, compute daily maximum temperature 3. For 2020-2024, find the maximum of daily maxima across all June days 4. Compare with June 24, 2025 daily maximum Potential issues: - 2025 data may not be available yet (ERA5 has ~3-month lag). We need to handle C1. - Need to ensure we're comparing like with like (same metric, same location) - Handle cloud masking? Not needed for ERA5 (reanalysis) - Check for valid pixels Edge cases: - If no 2025 data: C1 - If no 2020-2024 data: C1 - If valid pixel count = 0: C2 - If result is NaN: C3 We'll use: - ERA5-Land: "ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY" (has temperature_2m in Kelvin) - Convert Kelvin to Celsius - Compute daily maximum using hourly data - Use point geometry for JFK ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometry (JFK Airport) const jfk = ee.Geometry.Point([-73.7781, 40.6413]); // 2. Function to get daily max temperature for a specific date async function getDailyMaxTemp(dateStr) { const date = ee.Date(dateStr); const nextDay = date.advance(1, 'day'); const collection = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY') .filterDate(date, nextDay) .select('temperature_2m'); const count = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`${dateStr} Images: ${count}`); if (count === 0) { return {temp: null, validPixels: 0}; } // Convert K to C and get daily max const dailyMax = collection.map(img => img.subtract(273.15)) .max(); // Check valid pixels const pixelCount = dailyMax.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: jfk, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('temperature_2m').getInfo(); if (pixelCount === 0) { return {temp: null, validPixels: 0}; } // Get temperature value const temp = dailyMax.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: jfk, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('temperature_2m').getInfo(); return {temp: temp, validPixels: pixelCount}; } // 3. Function to get max June temperature for a specific year async function getJuneMaxTemp(year) { const juneStart = ee.Date(`${year}-06-01`); const julyStart = ee.Date(`${year}-07-01`); const collection = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY') .filterDate(juneStart, julyStart) .select('temperature_2m'); const count = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`June ${year} Images: ${count}`); if (count === 0) { return {temp: null, validPixels: 0}; } // Convert K to C and get max over all hours in June const juneMax = collection.map(img => img.subtract(273.15)) .max(); // Check valid pixels const pixelCount = juneMax.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: jfk, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('temperature_2m').getInfo(); if (pixelCount === 0) { return {temp: null, validPixels: 0}; } // Get temperature value const temp = juneMax.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: jfk, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('temperature_2m').getInfo(); return {temp: temp, validPixels: pixelCount}; } // 4. Get temperature for June 24, 2025 console.log("Getting temperature for June 24, 2025..."); const temp2025 = await getDailyMaxTemp('2025-06-24'); if (temp2025.temp === null) { if (temp2025.validPixels === 0) { console.log("C2: No valid pixels for 2025-06-24"); console.log("C2"); } else { console.log("C1: No data for 2025-06-24"); console.log("C1"); } return; } console.log(`2025-06-24 Temp: ${temp2025.temp.toFixed(2)}°C, Pixels: ${temp2025.validPixels}`); // 5. Get max temperatures for June 2020-2024 let maxTemp2020_2024 = -Infinity; let hasValidData = false; for (let year = 2020; year <= 2024; year++) { console.log(`\nGetting max temperature for June ${year}...`); const result = await getJuneMaxTemp(year); if (result.temp !== null) { hasValidData = true; console.log(`June ${year} Max Temp: ${result.temp.toFixed(2)}°C, Pixels: ${result.validPixels}`); if (result.temp > maxTemp2020_2024) { maxTemp2020_2024 = result.temp; } } else { if (result.validPixels === 0) { console.log(`C2: No valid pixels for June ${year}`); console.log("C2"); return; } else { console.log(`C1: No data for June ${year}`); console.log("C1"); return; } } } if (!hasValidData) { console.log("C1: No valid data for 2020-2024"); console.log("C1"); return; } // 6. Validate results if (temp2025.temp === undefined || temp2025.temp === null || isNaN(temp2025.temp) || !isFinite(temp2025.temp) || maxTemp2020_2024 === undefined || maxTemp2020_2024 === null || isNaN(maxTemp2020_2024) || !isFinite(maxTemp2020_2024)) { console.log("C3: Invalid temperature values"); console.log("C3"); return; } // Check for unrealistic temperatures (outside -60 to 60°C range) if (temp2025.temp < -60 || temp2025.temp > 60 || maxTemp2020_2024 < -60 || maxTemp2020_2024 > 60) { console.log("C3: Temperature outside valid range"); console.log("C3"); return; } // 7. Compare and output result console.log(`\nComparison:`); console.log(`2025-06-24 Temperature: ${temp2025.temp.toFixed(2)}°C`); console.log(`Max June Temp 2020-2024: ${maxTemp2020_2024.toFixed(2)}°C`); console.log(`Is 2025 temp higher? ${temp2025.temp > maxTemp2020_2024}`); if (temp2025.temp > maxTemp2020_2024) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
